page.layout: One text column at left with marginal notes at right; running head at top, printed page number 191 at top right, catchword "ab" at bottom right. Right margin: note "b Gregor." beside the first lines; then notes beside the Casus paragraph, including Greek notes, "Casus 46", "Hesych." and "Suid."

main_text.p: bat, aut voluit ab audientibus intelligi: non autem in eo sensu quemcunque ipsi postea libuerit illis verbis affingere. Deus enim qui aspicit cor, non luditur verbis : {b}Nec debet intentio verbis in-fervire, sed verba intentioni,Gregor. 26.Moral. 7. & habetur 22.q.§.
main_text.head: SECT. IX.
main_text.p: Casus Secundus est de Iuramentis & promissionibus {c}ἐπακτοῖς, id est eis quæ juranti ab alio deferuntur; sive quæ alius quispiam aliquo aut jure suo aut juris prætextu à jurante exigit. Qualia sunt ea imprimis, quæ à Rectoribus pro authoritate sua subditis imperantur, aut legibus sunt constituta: ut apud nos Iuramenta Suprematus Regii & Fidelitatis; & ea quæ ex statutis Academiæ ab eis exiguntur qui ad gradus promoventur, aliáque similia. Item ea quæ ex justâ conventione partium ab alterutro con-trahentium postulantur: ut ea quæ in pactis, fæderibus, aliisque civilibus con-tractibus ad mutuam fidem confirmandam interveniunt. Pro responsione in hac casu dico, Istiusmodi juramenta regulariter intelligi debere in eo sensu, quem probabiliter judicari potest fuisse abCasus 46 ἐπακτ[illegible, ~6 letters] ὅρκῳ, ἐφ' ὧν ἐπ[illegible, ~4 letters] ἀγει. ἐκ αὐθαιρέ[?]τῳ. Hesych. ὁ ἀλλαχοῦ [illegible, ~5 letters] ἐπιτιμ[?]ῶ. Suid.

page.notes: Greek marginal note beside "Casus" is only partly legible; its uncertain letters are marked as illegible or with [?]. The Greek word after "promissionibus" (ἐπακτοῖς) is read with some doubt. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, so "Casus" and "est" appear as s-forms. The reference mark "b" in the text is written as {b} before "Nec". The word "ab" at the foot is treated as a catchword. The last line of the note text has a faint stop beside it, which is not transcribed.
